summary_markdown:
The session involved sharing visual media (pictures and videos) of the Perfumes & Cosmetics sections within Dubai Duty Free Concourse B to assist in understanding the environment for Ouster. Links were provided for both Right/East wing and Left/West wing areas.

Additionally, several technical resources and code links were shared via GitHub, including a people detector implementation and a bayes people tracker repository.
